Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.extension

Schnittstelle ExtensionManager

public interface ExtensionManager
Registers and sequences NpcExtensions.

Obtained from BetterNPCsApi.extensionManager(). All methods must be called on the main server thread.

  • Methodendetails

    • register

      void register(NpcExtension extension)
      Registers an extension, enabling it immediately if its dependencies allow.

      Registering an extension can enable others: anything that was ExtensionManager.State.PENDING waiting for this one is enabled as part of the same call, in dependency order.

      Parameter:
      extension - the extension to register
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if extension is null
      IllegalStateException - if an extension with the same id is already registered

    • unregister

      boolean unregister(String id)
      Disables and removes an extension, along with everything registered while it was enabled.

      Extensions that depend on it are disabled first, and become ExtensionManager.State.PENDING again rather than being removed, so re-registering restores the whole chain.

      Parameter:
      id - the extension id
      Gibt zurück:
      true if an extension was removed
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if id is null

      default boolean isEnabled(String id)

    • unsatisfiedDependencies

      Set<String> unsatisfiedDependencies()
      Returns the ids that registered extensions depend on but which nothing provides.

      Reported at the end of startup, so that a forgotten plugin is a clear message rather than an extension silently doing nothing.

      Gibt zurück:
      an immutable set of unsatisfied dependency ids
